title: mixcore core API v0.4: shared definitions

version.description: Contract version. v0 is unstable until the first tagged release.

kind.description: muteGroup and dca are v0.1 (x32: mute groups 1..6, DCA groups 1..8; xair, v0.2: mute groups 1..4, DCA groups 1..4). Their only field is mute. headamp is v0.3: a preamp (the physical input, not the channel). Index: xair /headamp/NN is NN (01..16 mic, fewer on XR16/XR12, XA-F73; 17 aux on the 18-channel models); x32 /headamp/NNN is NNN + 1 (1..32 local, 33..80 AES50 A, 81..128 AES50 B, X32-F70). UI text never shows the index: it names a headamp by its snapshot entry's bank and number ('Local 1', 'AES50 A 05', 'Aux'). Fields: gain, phantom (read-only). Which channel a headamp feeds: x32 input field headamp; xair not modelled (insrc unverified, XA-F115). bus and matrix are v0.4. bus: a mix bus (x32 1..16, X32-F80) or, on xair, buses 1..6 and the FX send masters as buses 7..10 (xair.md section 3.1); the snapshot's buses list gives each one's kind (mix or fx). Fields of a bus: name, colour (read-only), fader, mute, linked (read-only, odd bus of a pair only). matrix (v0.4, x32 1..6, X32-F87): name, colour, fader, mute, all read-only. v0.4 also gives a dca strip the fields name, colour (read-only) and fader where the console has DCA masters (snapshot dcas entries carry faderDB).

index.description: Required for input, muteGroup, dca, headamp, bus and matrix (1-based). Omitted for main.

field.description: v0.1: muteGroups and dcas are the strip's group membership (read-only); effectiveMute is derived by the core and appears only in state messages, never in commands. For a muteGroup strip, mute true means the group is engaged (muting its members); for a dca strip, mute true means the DCA is muted. v0.2: a strip without a membership on its console has no such field: on xair the main strip belongs to no mute group and no DCA (docs/protocols/xair.md section 3.2), so a set or read of main muteGroups is ERR_UNSUPPORTED and state messages omit it. v0.3: gain is the dB gain of a headamp strip (CR-23); phantom (headamp, read-only) is its 48 V, true = on, only on headamps whose snapshot entry has phantom (x32 local, xair mic); headamp (input, read-only, x32 only, /-ha/NN/index) is the index of the headamp that feeds the channel, null when its source has none (card, USB, internal). A set of phantom or headamp is ERR_UNSUPPORTED. Trim (x32 /ch/NN/preamp/trim) is not modelled yet and not bounded by the core. v0.4: colour (read-only) is the strip colour the console shows (colour token); linked (read-only, a bus, true = the bus pair odd/even is linked as one stereo bus; only on the odd bus of each pair); sendLevel, sendOn, sendPan and sendTap are the send of an input strip to the bus named by the param's bus member: sendLevel a level (dB), sendOn a boolean (true = the send is on; xair has no send on/off, XA section 3.3), sendPan a pan (-100..+100), sendTap a sendTap token (read-only in v0.4). On x32 sendPan and sendTap exist on odd buses only and belong to the bus pair (X32-F84, X32-F85); the snapshot's sendFields says so.

bus.description: v0.4: the destination bus of a send field (sendLevel, sendOn, sendPan, sendTap); required for them and absent for every other field. At most 64 (ERR_INVALID_COMMAND above).

level.description: A level in dB. JSON has no infinity, so fully off is the string "-inf". NaN never appears.

value.description: fader, gain (v0.3) and sendLevel (v0.4): level; mute, phantom (v0.3), sendOn and linked (v0.4): boolean (true = muted, or for a muteGroup: engaged; phantom: 48 V on; sendOn: the send is on; linked: the bus pair is linked); name: string; muteGroups/dcas (v0.1): groupList; effectiveMute (v0.1): effectiveMute object; headamp (v0.3): headamp index or null; sendPan (v0.4): pan; sendTap (v0.4): sendTap token; colour (v0.4): colour token. The field decides the type.

groupList.description: v0.1: group numbers in ascending order, e.g. [2, 5].

effectiveMute.description: v0.1 (design CR-01, SR-04): whether the strip is silenced toward Main LR, and why. muted = own OR any listed group. Additive (wing): muted is null when the core cannot tell (basis partial): a mute group whose membership the console does not report is engaged, or the console reported a value whose meaning is unknown. A UI draws null as 'mute state unknown', never as live. basis: derived (computed from own mute, membership and group states, all known: x32, xair), console (the console reported the strip's effective mute itself: wing $mute), partial (an input is unknown; muted is null). own true always gives muted true. muteGroups lists the engaged mute groups the strip belongs to; dcas lists the muted DCAs it belongs to (x32: a muted DCA silences its members toward Main LR only, unless the console preference says otherwise; per-bus effective mute comes with buses; xair: the same rule, XA section 3; its main strip has no membership, so its effective mute is its own mute). UI text: 'MUTED by MG 2', 'DCA 1 muted'.

basis.description: Additive (wing). Absent in older cores means derived.

pan.description: v0.4: a pan position, -100 = hard left, 0 = centre, +100 = hard right. x32 and xair store 101 positions (step 2, X32-F84, xair.md section 4); the core rounds to the console's step.

sendTap.description: v0.4: where a send taps the channel, in signal-flow order: input (after the input stage / low cut), preEq, postEq, preFader, postFader, group (the bus works as a subgroup). The UI shows the console's own word for it from the snapshot's sendTaps list (x32: IN/LC, <-EQ, EQ->, PRE, POST, GRP, X32-F85; xair: IN, PREEQ, POSTEQ, PRE, POST, GRP, xair.md section 3.3), untranslated (CR-16).

colour.description: v0.4: the console's strip colour (x32 X32-F89, xair section 3.2: int 0..15 = OFF, RD, GN, YE, BL, MG, CY, WH, then the same inverted). Inverted colours are drawn hollow (design 1.1).
